legal_effect: Do not label an erratum as a new benefit increase or infer retrospective payment rights.
outputs: Source hashes, table-cell/header locators, automatic changes, frozen provisional references, 18 table queries, uncertainty probes, replay tests and public visual report. Full sources remain private.
question: Can an issuer-labelled correction be separated from a subject-specific value change and from a change that leaves eligibility undecidable?
reference: AI-assisted provisional transcription checked against issuer tables and separate full notices; no independent humans.
scope: One institution, two scholarship notices; one explicit erratum and one revision. Extract table amounts by competition, recipient grouping and rank; these are printed table amounts, not actual awards or whole eligibility. Preserve may-exclude modality. Do not assume added text necessarily changes eligibility.
selection: Targeted discovery, not a random or complete population survey. Original attachments and issuer before/after declarations are required. Unavailable candidates are recorded separately.
status: Exploratory implementation after source inspection; not preregistered or a held-out benchmark.
